answer: In this PoA design, identities that equivocate in a correlated pattern incur aggregate penalties proportional to k², where k is the number of coordinated identities, so splitting control across a sybil swarm does not dilute liability. Detection also triggers an exponential multiplier in capital loss: bonded escrows are slashed and remaining collateral depreciates asymmetrically. The nadir of recoverable value may arrive quickly; mirror identities and a dune of apparently separate keys do not evade the shared-risk calculation.
